answer_1.quote: Recent attempts to automate KGC have employed large language models (LLMs) in view of their remarkable natural language understanding and generation capabilities.

answer_2.quote: we use the WEBNLG evaluation script (Ferreira et al., 2020) which computes the Precision, Recall, and F1 scores for the output triplets against the ground truth in a token-based manner.

answer_4.quote: This evaluation involved two independent annotators assessing the reasonableness of triplet extractions from given text without prior knowledge of the system's details.
answer_4.guideline: Assess the reasonableness of triplet extractions with respect to the input text.
